subject: general
question: Who among the followings was an Indian singer of the Khayal genre of Hindustani classical music from Karnataka?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gangubai Hangal.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gangubai Hangal** was a** Hindustani classical singer of the Khyal genre from Karnataka.**
 
• She received a numeral of awards which includes -** the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award for Hindustani Music -Vocal, Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan, and Gangubai Hangal belonged to Kirana Gharana.**
 
• She was known for her deep and powerful voice.** **
 
• She performed all over India and for** ****All India Radio stations until 1945.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​**Ravi Shankar **was an Indian sitarist and composer.
 
• **Akhtari Bai Faizabadi,** also known as **Begum Akhtar,** was an Indian singer and actress. Dubbed **"Mallika-e-Ghazal"**, she is considered one of the important singers of** ghazal, dadra, and thumri genres of Hindustani classical music.**
 
• **Durga Jasraj is an Indian original content producer.**
